source_title: Bose QuietComfort Headphones for $199 is a price we didn't see coming
source_excerpt:
Bose has been making great audio products for a few decades now at this point, and it's showing no signs of slowing down. We've reviewed a few of its personal audio products and they all score top marks, offering impressive sound that's worth talking about .
And when it has great products, it only makes sense that at some point it would come out with something better, which is where the Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) come in. We loved the originals , but the newer models really take things to another level.
The price has come down dramatically
When it comes to the design, you're getting something sleek and refined, with attention to detail that enables the headphones to provide enhanced comfort when worn for long periods. They're also lightweight and compact, coming in at just 230 grams.
There's ANC, which can easily cancel any external noise to prevent distractions, and spatial audio makes it possible to enjoy immersive sound experiences. You can also take the audio up a notch by going wired with USB-C cables, with support for 24bit/48kHz lossless audio.
As far as battery life goes, you're looking at 25 hours on a single charge. There's also quick charging that will give you two and half hours of use with a 15-minute charge. The $359 price tag isn't all that bad to be honest, but the new $199 price tag is even better.
That's 45% off the usual retail price, but it only currently applies to the Dewdrop Mint, Eucalyptus Green, and Hazelnut Taupe colors from Amazon. You can grab the other colors if you want, but you will pay a little more at $219.
Regardless, it's easy to recommend these headphones at these current prices. You can't go wrong with the Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) when they're on sale.
